entities.name: Romanian Orthodox Cathedral, Vršac
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Cathedral of the Ascension of the Lord, also known as the Romanian Orthodox Cathedral is an Eastern Orthodox church located in Vršac, Serbia. It is under jurisdiction of the Diocese of Dacia Felix of the Romanian Orthodox Church and serves as its cathedral church.
